title: Pure Exchange of the Spirit
summary: Exchange of the Spirit is Ishizu Ishtar's EARTH Fairy graveyard-control strategy centered around Gravekeeper's Trap, Exchange of the Spirit, and Blast Held by Destiny. Fully compliant with the TCG Banlist (where Kelbek the Ancient Vanguard and Agido the Ancient Sentinel are Forbidden, and Keldo the Sacred Protector and Mudora the Sword Oracle are Limited to 1), this build pairs the legal Ishizu Fairies and Zolga the Prophet with Vernusylph EARTH Fairy extenders to lock the opponent out of their GY and draws via Gravekeeper's Trap.

allow.Vernusylph of the Flourishing Hills: Level 4 EARTH Fairy that discards itself and a monster or Vernusylph card to search a Vernusylph and revive an EARTH monster from the GY.
allow.Vernusylph of the Awakening Forests: Level 4 EARTH Fairy that discards itself and a monster to send any EARTH monster that can be Normal Summoned (Keldo, Mudora, or Zolga the Prophet!) from the Deck to the GY.
allow.Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings: Level 3 EARTH Fairy that discards itself and a monster to search ANY Level 4 or lower EARTH Fairy monster from the Deck (searching Keldo, Mudora, or Zolga the Prophet!).
allow.Herald of Orange Light: EARTH/LIGHT Fairy handtrap that discards itself and a Fairy (Keldo or Mudora!) to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect.
allow.Foolish Burial Goods: Sends Exchange of the Spirit directly from the Deck to the GY so Gravekeeper's Trap's GY floodgate and Keldo/Mudora's 5-card shuffles are immediately active (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Keldo the Sacred Protector or Mudora the Sword Oracle directly from the Deck to the GY (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 EARTH Xyz made with two Level 4 EARTH Fairies that stalls the board while Gravekeeper's Trap strips the opponent's draws.
allow.Missus Radiant: Link-2 EARTH monster that boosts all EARTH Fairies by 500 ATK/DEF and recovers an EARTH monster from the GY when destroyed.

main: Keldo the Sacred Protector

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and search Exchange of the Spirit or any card that mentions it, and banishes itself from field/GY as a Quick Effect to shuffle up to 5 cards from either GY into the Deck.
Mudora the Sword Oracle

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards 1 EARTH Fairy to Special Summon itself and place Gravekeeper's Trap face-up directly from your Deck, and banishes itself from field/GY as a Quick Effect to shuffle up to 5 cards from either GY into the Deck.
Zolga the Prophet

Ishizu's Level 4 EARTH Fairy that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control an EARTH Fairy (except Zolga) and looks at the top 5 cards of BOTH Decks—guaranteeing you know the exact top card of the opponent's Deck to snipe it with Gravekeeper's Trap!
Kelbek
Original TCG-legal Level 4 EARTH Fairy from Ishizu's deck that returns any monster that attacks it back to the owner's hand and fuels discard costs for Gravekeeper's Trap and Vernusylphs.
Mudora
Original TCG-legal Level 4 EARTH Fairy that gains 200 ATK for every Fairy monster in your GY.
Vernusylph of the Misting Seedlings
Discards itself and 1 monster to search ANY Level 4 EARTH Fairy (Keldo the Sacred Protector, Mudora the Sword Oracle, or Zolga the Prophet!) from your Deck and revive an EARTH monster.
Vernusylph of the Awakening Forests
Discards itself and 1 monster to send Keldo the Sacred Protector or Mudora the Sword Oracle directly from your Deck to the GY and revive an EARTH monster.
Vernusylph of the Flourishing Hills
Discards itself and 1 card to search another Vernusylph and protect your EARTH monsters from effect destruction.
Herald of Orange Light
Unlimited in TCG: discards itself and an EARTH Fairy from hand to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect, putting Keldo or Mudora into the GY on Turn 0.
Gravekeeper's Trap

Core Continuous Trap: while Exchange of the Spirit is in your GY, prevents your opponent from activating card effects in the GY or Special Summoning from the GY; discards 1 card to search any Level 4 EARTH Fairy; and declares the card your opponent draws to send it to the GY (100% accurate with Zolga the Prophet!).
Exchange of the Spirit
Signature Trap that swaps both players' GYs with their Decks when both GYs have 15+ cards, and serves as the required GY enabler for Gravekeeper's Trap, Blast Held by Destiny, Keldo, and Mudora.
Blast Held by Destiny
Signature Trap searchable by Keldo that destroys the opponent's highest-ATK monster on attack declaration to burn for its ATK, and banishes itself from the GY to recover a Level 4 EARTH Fairy.
Foolish Burial Goods
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Exchange of the Spirit directly from the Deck to the GY so Gravekeeper's Trap's GY floodgate is immediately live.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Keldo or Mudora directly from the Deck to the GY.
extra: Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
